faq.question: Can I record multiple LinkedIn videos in one session?
faq.answer: Yes. This is often the best approach. Prepare several topics and Birdcast can help you record them efficiently in one studio visit.

faq.question: Do I need a full script for LinkedIn videos?
faq.answer: No. A script can help, but LinkedIn content often feels more natural when it is built from strong bullet points and a clear message.

faq.question: Can the videos be used outside LinkedIn?
faq.answer: Yes. LinkedIn-style videos can often be adapted for websites, newsletters, Instagram, YouTube Shorts or TikTok-style clips.

faq.question: Is this useful for real estate brokers and consultants?
faq.answer: Yes. Brokers, consultants, coaches and founders can use the format for market commentary, advice, expertise and personal brand content.

faq.question: What should I send before booking?
faq.answer: Send your topics, audience, preferred tone and examples of videos you like so the team can suggest a practical recording format.
